categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies SQLite wallet storage and schema in src/wallet/sqlite.cpp, src/wallet/walletdb.cpp, and related wallet files.
categories.rationale: Migrating SQLite transaction storage from a key-value store to a dedicated relational table is a major architectural improvement to wallet persistence. It eliminates arbitrary-order record loading headaches during wallet initialization and simplifies sequential transaction history handling for downstream work like #27865.
